{{Quote|With his army well-trained, Vaiken led a campaign to carve a footprint into the wilderness of Dromund Kaas to create room for the Empire's new capital to flourish.|Jedi Master Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Timeline11" />}}
Shortly after their arrival on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], the people of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reborn Sith Empire]] launched a '''campaign to clear a wilderness region''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The effort was conceived and organized by the founder and first leader of the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]], [[Odile Vaiken]]. Vaiken led a newly-formed [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|army]] of Imperial revivalists into the jungle wilds of the untamed Dromund Kaas, carving into the habitats of native animal [[Species/Legends|species]] and clearing the way for the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] to gain a secure foothold on the world. When the project reached completion, the Imperials had cleared enough of the wilderness to allow for their leaders to begin building a new [[Capital/Legends|capital]] that would later come to be known as [[Kaas City]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|The survivors finally settled on the jungle world of Dromund Kaas. There, the Emperor revealed his vision to build a new civilization of unrivaled efficiency.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Timeline11" />}}
[[File:Dromund_Kaas_rally.jpg|thumb|left|270px|The newly arrived Imperials heed the words of their Emperor.]]
In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]],<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] defeated the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] and his great [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] at the close of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. Although the war had broken the backbone of the Empire and its people, the Republic's [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]]<ref name="Timeline12">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 12: The Great Hyperspace War|int=Timeline 12: The Great Hyperspace War}}</ref> [[Pultimo]]<ref name="Warfare" /> insisted that his forces continue their assault against the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] in order to fully [[Post–Great Hyperspace War counterinvasion|eliminate]] any vestigial threat posed to the safety of the Republic.<ref name="Timeline12" /> Fearing persecution, a group of Imperials fled from their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] and the rest of [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith space]] to seek asylum with the surviving [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] known as [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]] elsewhere in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Under the leadership of Vitiate, who quickly declared himself the undying Sith [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]],<ref name="Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref> these survivors traveled [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] for twenty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before discovering the lost [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]<ref name="Timeline11" /> in [[4980 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> The jungle world had once played host to a Sith colonization effort, but had long since been forgotten. The Sith Emperor accepted Dromund Kaas as the capital for a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|new Empire]] that could one day challenge the Republic, but simultaneously retreated into the shadows while his [[Dark Council]] of Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lords]] managed the building of the new government.<ref name="Timeline11" />

One of the first priorities set out for the Great Hyperspace War survivors was the taming of Dromund Kaas. The planet was a jungle wilderness teeming with aggressive wildlife that would need to be cleared before building could begin. To accomplish the task, the Dark Council looked to [[Odile Vaiken]], a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-deaf [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who had accepted the responsibility of forging a new [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] for use by his Sith overlords. After drafting every able-bodied adult into a fledgling [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|army]], Vaiken created an intense [[Imperial Military training regimen|training regimen]] to bring his forces up to fighting conditions. Once his [[Army/Legends|army]] was organized and trained, Vaiken began to execute his masters' plans to secure Dromund Kaas.<ref name="Timeline11" />

==The campaign==
{{Quote|Records suggest that during the campaign, he personally slew a rabid terentatek on the site where the Imperial Citadel stands today.|Gnost-Dural, referring to the exploits of Odile Vaiken|<ref name="Timeline11" />}}
With his newly-trained army of [[Imperial soldier]]s, Vaiken marched into the jungles of Dromund Kaas and began poaching the native animals and clearing the forests. Clad in [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and wielding [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]], the [[Troop/Legends|troops]] engaged and [[Death/Legends|killed]] many [[yozusk]]s and other creatures. Vaiken himself participated in the combat and personally fought a large, rabid [[Terentatek/Legends|terentatek]] beast. Although the animal nearly got the upper hand, Vaiken managed to slay the terentatek and claim the region on behalf of the Empire.<ref name="Timeline11" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|After establishing the Empire's dominion on Dromund Kaas, Vaiken turned his attention to constructing a new Imperial Navy.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Timeline11" />}}
[[File:Vaiken_Tarentatek.jpg|thumb|right|270px|Odile Vaiken kills a rabid terentatek in the Dromund Kaas jungle.]]
With a vast swath of the jungle cleared, Imperial builders were able to move in and begin construction on a new [[Capital/Legends|capital]] for a revived Sith Empire. The [[City/Legends|metropolis]] that sprang up in the area was named [[Kaas City]] and was centered around a massive building dubbed the [[Imperial Citadel (Sith Empire)|Imperial Citadel]], which was built over the site of Vaiken's clash with the terentatek. While the Emperor and Dark Council ruled their new dominion from the city, Vaiken went about the business of enhancing their military.<ref name="Timeline11" />

The Human helped to design a new [[Harrower-class dreadnought|class]] of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] and harnessed the strength of the Imperial people to build a new [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|naval armada]] from scratch. Vaiken's work was hugely successful, and his new army and [[Navy/Legends|navy]] were tasked with expanding the boundaries of the Emperor's reign by conquering the worlds surrounding Dromund Kaas. Vaiken's work in building military strength for the Sith earned him the favor of the Dark Council and the Emperor himself, who proclaimed Vaiken to be the first [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] of the new Empire. Over a [[Time/Legends|millennium]] later, in the aftermath of the Imperial Military's victory in the [[Great Galactic War]], the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]] recorded a [[Holodocumentary|holovid]] that traced the beginning of the reconstituted Sith Empire and Vaiken's efforts on Dromund Kaas.<ref name="Timeline11" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sith Empire's campaign to clear the wilderness of Dromund Kaas had its first and only appearance in the [[Timeline 11: Rebirth of the Sith Empire|eleventh entry]] of the ''[[Galactic Timeline]]''. The Timeline, an online video feature, was created to provide information on background lore in the [[BioWare]]/[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Timeline11" />
